functions.name: user_follow_relationships
functions.description: Canonical directed follow edges with stable ordered follower and followed identities. Incoming and outgoing listings unify at the same pair grain. Follows are not organization/team memberships; count distinct actors only by their explicit role.

metrics.name: user_follow_relationship_count
metrics.comment: Selected user_follow_relationships rows at the declared entity grain.

metrics.name: distinct_follower_count
metrics.comment: Distinct follower_id identities in the selected directed follow population; non-additive across groups.

metrics.name: distinct_followed_user_count
metrics.comment: Distinct followed_id identities in the selected directed follow population; non-additive across groups.

arguments.name: followed_user
arguments.description: Login of the account being followed, distinct from its followers.

routes.population: All advertised pages of directed follow relationships; each follower/followed pair counts once. The selected account is the followed role for followers, or follower role for following.

functions.name: user_context_observations
functions.description: Typed user hovercard context observations. Subject IDs stay opaque strings; none plus an empty subject ID identifies the explicit context-free scope. Messages are descriptions, not membership or permission assertions.

metrics.comment: Selected user_context_observations rows at the declared entity grain.

arguments.description: Hovercard context subject type; requires user_context_subject_id. The subject is distinct from the user being described.
